test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question some conditions or circumstances is provided to you, you have to make logical judgement according to mentioned circumstances and mark the correct judgement for question.

Statement: The university has made attendance tracking through facial recognition mandatory.

Judgement I: This is an effective way to curb bunking.

Judgement II: This raises privacy concerns.

options.text: Both Judgements I and II follow
Neither Judgement I nor II follows

solution:
**Statement:** The university has made attendance tracking through facial recognition mandatory.

**Judgement I:** This is an effective way to curb bunking. ⇒ Facial recognition can help monitor attendance accurately and reduce proxy attendance or absenteeism. Hence, this judgement follows.

**Judgement II:** This raises privacy concerns. ⇒ The use of facial recognition technology involves collection and storage of biometric data, which may create concerns regarding privacy and misuse of personal information. Hence, this judgement also follows.

**Here, both Judgements I and II follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
